scope: Scalar register byte offsets for RDNA2 MUBUF operations in packaged compute shaders. Every reaching path supplies zero at the measured uses.
comparison: Replace the SOFFSET byte of each SGPR-addressed MUBUF with inline zero (0x80), except scalar-only atomics that already accept dynamic offsets. Translate the original and modified ISA with the same container metadata. The complete HLSL sources match byte for byte.
validation: DXC and DXV for all three original shader streams
